title: Jad sandbox template
description: One sandbox template, <catalogs.sandbox>/<name>.json (default .jad/sandbox), named "<name>" by root defaults, sessions, profiles (settings.sandbox) and sub-agents (the agent key sandbox), with or without overrides ({"template": "<name>", ...}). Its keys are those of the setting key sandbox (setting.schema.json); every path is a placeholder or an absolute path, filled in for each run, so one template serves every profile and agent that names it. enabled is required, and a template cannot name another one. Editing a template reloads the sessions that use it; the folder is read-only inside every bwrap and seatbelt sandbox.
